description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

626 is a provider of diagnostic imaging equipment services, maintenance, asset management, and lifecycle solutions. The Full Stack JavaScript Developer builds and maintains web applications, mobile apps, and cloud backend services, owning features from design through deployment and helping ensure service reliability.
Full Stack Developer building React and React Native interfaces, developing REST APIs and services, and deploying and testing cloud applications

Responsibilities:
• Build responsive, accessible user interfaces in TypeScript, using React for web and React Native for mobile
• Design and develop REST APIs and backend services with NestJS and Express
• Deploy, monitor and troubleshoot services in Azure, with some work in AWS
• Own the quality of your work, with no separate QA team: write unit, integration and end-to-end tests, and take part in code reviews
• Work with stakeholders across the business to turn requirements into shipped features, from new builds to enhancements of existing systems
• Debug production issues and help improve performance, security and reliability
• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, documentation and team engineering practices

Requirements:
• 1–4 years of professional experience building web applications (or equivalent project work)
• Solid JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals
• Hands-on experience with React or React Native, including hooks, state management and component design
• Experience building APIs with Node.js using Express or NestJS
• Working knowledge of relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL
• Familiarity with Git, pull-request workflows and automated testing
• Exposure to a cloud platform, ideally Azure or AWS
• Clear communication and a willingness to ask questions, learn and take ownership

Preferred:
• Experience with Azure DevOps (repos, boards, pipelines) and Azure services such as App Service or Azure Functions
• Familiarity with AWS services such as Lambda, S3 or EC2
• Docker and containerized deployments
• Interest in healthcare technology or field-service operations
• Testing tools such as Jest, React Testing Library or Playwright
• Understanding of authentication (OAuth, JWT, Entra ID) and web security basics
